notablePrerequisites:
Mercurial Pretender on the battlefield as a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Mercurial Pretender do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Mercurial Pretender.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Mercurial Pretender.
Activate Mercurial Pretender by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Mercurial Pretender ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.
